name: caveman-compress
title: Caveman Compress
description: Compresses memory files such as CLAUDE.md or todo lists into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup outside the tree.
why: Long-lived context files are re-read every session; compressing them is a permanent input-token saving rather than a one-off.
adaptations: License note: the GitHub API declares this repo Apache-2.0 and the vendored LICENSE is the Apache-2.0 text, but the repo also ships a separate MIT license file (LICENSE-MIT) for parts of the project; the skill folder is recorded as Apache-2.0. Content imported unmodified.
